extracted.intended_audience: historians and general readers interested in 16th-century Spanish colonial accounts (Manila/Luzon)
extracted.subtask_description: Transcription/edition of a 16th-century Spanish account describing the voyage, negotiations, conflict, and acts of possession in Manila/Luzon (c.1570), including letters and notarial declarations. The text is a primary-source narrative useful for historians of colonial Philippines, maritime expeditions, and Spanish–Moro/Chinese contacts.
